scope: Eight frozen shared_fixed candidates: two seeds × two source objectives × random/coactivation groups. Natural eval documents32–63, all4096positions/all32groups. No fitting or gate selection.
definitions: Selected membership requires gate active. Exclusive atoms have active membership count1; shared atoms count2. Gate removal deletes exclusive only. Shared-atom removal differs by deleting atoms still selected by another gate. Freeze original encoder coordinates and other gates; no rerouting.
identity: selected=exclusive disjoint-union shared, union-after-gate=union minus exclusive. Decoded union delta=exclusive delta+shared delta. Atom-disjoint supports need not have orthogonal decoded vectors; report cross term.
audit: Every group/position exact masks; independent set membership and NumPy decodes at eight fixed positions per candidate. No empirical outcome-based sample choice.
next: Native external-write interventions using exclusive/shared/union deltas, paired random/coactivation controls, noops retained and conditional token/context baselines. A gate protection identity alone is not native computational reuse.
